keys.name: APPLE_CLIENT_ID
keys.description: Read on each Apple sign-in; Apple sign-in fails while unset.

keys.name: DISCORD_CLIENT_ID
keys.description: Read on each Discord sign-in; Discord sign-in fails while unset.

keys.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
keys.description: Read on each Google sign-in; Google sign-in fails while unset.

keys.name: KEYCLOAK_ISSUER
keys.description: Operator sign-in is disabled unless this and KEYCLOAK_OPERATOR_CLIENT_ID are set.

keys.name: KEYCLOAK_OPERATOR_CLIENT_ID
keys.description: Operator sign-in is disabled unless this and KEYCLOAK_ISSUER are set.

keys.name: NOTIFICATION_GRPC_ADDR
keys.description: Checked at startup but never dialled: notification-service serves no gRPC.
